decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (028-PE-XX-99-DR-A-011 Rev P01, 028-PE-XX-ZZ-DR-A-010 Rev P01 (received 27/06/2013)
028-PE-XX-99-DR-A-009 Rev P04 (received 21/08/2013)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The temporary buildings and hard standing hereby permitted and other associated structures shall be removed from the site edged red and shown on Drawing No. 028-PE-XX-99-DR-A-009 Rev P04 within 13 months of the date of this permission. Within 3 months of removal or in the first planting season following removal, the playing field land shall be reinstated to a playing field of a quality at least equivalent to the quality of the playing field immediately before the temporary buildings and hard standing was erected and in accordance with 'Natural Turf for Sport', (Sport England, 2011).
description: Erection of a single storey temporary classroom building and formation of temporary hardstanding
